description: Checks an IPv4 mail-sending address against the SpamEatingMonkey DNS blocklist (bl.spameatingmonkey.net) through public DNS. A listed address returns its 127.0.0.x return code; an unlisted one returns no record. Listings change often; this is a point-in-time answer. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_spameatingmonkey
title: Security Spameatingmonkey
